title: Patient records, behind three checks
label: Patient records sit inside three rings: patient consent, de-identification and clinical access. A clinician's request passes all three and opens the care plan. A research pipeline's request passes consent and de-identification but is stopped at clinical access, which closes with the chip Blocked, no care link. The access log beside the rings shows 1 allowed and 1 blocked.
heading:
Only the care team
sees the chart.
sub: Consent, de-identification and access checks run on every read, and each one is on record for your compliance team.
